Product Title:
MuscleBlaze Micronised Creatine Monohydrate CreAMP Powder, Unflavoured (32 Servings, 100g)

Specifications:
- Brand: MuscleBlaze
- Flavour: Unflavoured
- Primary Supplement Type: Creatine Monohydrate
- Net Quantity: 100.0 Grams (32 Servings)
- Item Form: Micronised Powder
- Special Ingredients: Creatine, MB CreAbsorb Technology
- Diet Type: Vegetarian
- Product Benefits: Advanced Creatine Absorption, Energy Management, Muscle Strength & Endurance
- Certifications: Trustified Certified Quality for Purity and Safety

5-star reviews:
- "Genuine and quality product for gym and sports freak persons.": Quality is good as it is genuine micronized creatine monohydrate. Mixes seamlessly in my protein shake without leaving heavy residue.

4-star reviews:
- "Good performance boost": Noticed strength improvements in 2 weeks. Solubility in cold water takes a bit of extra stirring, but unflavored version mixes easily with juice.

3-star reviews:
- "Average packaging": Creatine power is good quality, but the scoop is buried deep inside and jar opening is narrow.

2-star reviews:
- "Mild stomach discomfort": Product is authentic with Trustified mark, but caused slight bloating when taken without extra water intake.

1-star reviews:
- "Damaged seal on delivery": Received jar with broken inner seal and powder spilled inside outer packaging. Return request took long time.
